newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ticks up $1 on supply, U.S arbbing.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ticks up $1 on supply, U.S arbbing.

text.p: NWE gasoline reversed some of yesterday's losses on Friday as refinery shut-downs, tight supplies and an arb window to the United States impacted.

Dealers said unleaded premium cargoes were hovering around $189-190 cif NWE, about $1 stronger while swaps were were 50 cents to $1 firmer. July was talked at $185-186 although there was more discussionon August around $186.00.
Lower refinery output resulting from two shut-downs was contributng to the tight market as was the recent arbing of cargoes to the United States.
Traders said the arb was open, but the suitable size cargoes becoming harder to find.
